outcome: A real agent change becomes an exact reviewable SCM candidate with current CI evidence and bounded repair.
currentProblem: The product needs a real external change/CI loop, not an internal success record detached from repository state.
constraints: Research must compare reuse and the smallest existing-Core approach, inspect primary sources and pin selected versions before READY.
Future dependency plans are assumptions, not delivered truth; worker execution requires delivered dependencies and a current Jev-satisfied plan.
Real-provider and live-product evidence must be identified separately from deterministic mocks; no fabricated API runs, costs or judgments.
successCriteria: The candidate records base SHA, exact resulting commit/tree, changed files and CI run identities from the real provider.
A deliberate failing check returns bounded repair; stale checks and unrelated branch updates cannot satisfy candidate acceptance.
Retry after lost provider acknowledgement discovers the existing change or blocks on ambiguity; it does not create duplicate review requests or bypass merge policy.
